definition: mlxtend (machine learning extensions) adds helpers to scikit-learn: stacking ensembles, feature selection, association rules and plotting.
details: Created and maintained by Sebastian Raschka since 2014.

explainer.lead: How to install mlxtend, a first working example, and where it fits in an AI project.

quickstart.python:
from mlxtend.classifier import StackingClassifier
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier
from sklearn.naive_bayes import GaussianNB
from sklearn.datasets import load_iris

X, y = load_iris(return_X_y=True)
stack = StackingClassifier(classifiers=[KNeighborsClassifier(), GaussianNB()],
                           meta_classifier=LogisticRegression())
print(stack.fit(X, y).score(X, y))

explainer.inAi: Quick ensembles and feature-selection experiments on top of scikit-learn models.
explainer.jsNote: mlxtend is a Python library with no official JavaScript or TypeScript package; call it from a Python service if your app is written in JavaScript.
